text.ko:

text.en:
■ Activates after landing {1} critical hits with normal attacks. Affects the target.
Sea Breeze: DEF ▼ {2}% of the skill user's DEF. Stacks up to {3} times and lasts for {4} sec.
■ Activates when HP falls below {5}%. Affects self and the {6} ally unit(s) with the highest final ATK (except the skill user).
Critical Damage ▲ {7}% continuously.
